title: Asking how often: milyen gyakran, minden

sections.content: To ask how often someone does something, put *milyen gyakran* before the verb: *Milyen gyakran sportolsz?* (How often do you do sport?) You can answer with one of the five frequency words from the last lesson, or with *minden* (every) and a time word.

sections.title: After minden
sections.content: After *minden* the time word stays singular. A day keeps its *-n*: *minden hétfőn*. The whole phrase goes before the verb: *Minden reggel olvasok.*

items.english: How often do you do sport?

sections.content: English says “every Monday” with no ending on Monday. In Hungarian the day keeps its *-n*: *minden hétfőn*, *minden pénteken*. Do not add a plural to the time word.
